systems.owner: Libyan Post Telecommunications & Information Technology Company (LPTIC) and its subsidiaries; connection contract signed in November 2023 by the Libyan United International Company
systems.tiers: International cable inaugurated at Misrata on 10 May 2025, said to improve internet service in Tripoli, Misrata and Benghazi; no local government office said to be on it

note: The inauguration of an international submarine cable; the Mayor of Misrata and municipal council members attended, and nothing is stated on the connection of any municipal office.
